voice_lines: Webvan burned about eight hundred million dollars delivering groceries.
It launched in nineteen ninety-nine with a simple promise: order online, get your food at the door.
One month in, it signed a one-billion-dollar deal for up to twenty-six giant warehouses.
On its first day of trading, it was valued at about eight billion dollars.
[dramatic] Less than two years later, the stock closed at six cents.
[serious] Two thousand workers lost their jobs, and Webvan filed for bankruptcy.
The lesson: prove the model, then scale it. Because
